title: Exclude adjacent changed-chart ADD swaps in the retained words (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** This package exhausts one adjacent normalized ADD exchange with a changed chart and a shared owned operand on the retained complex and BIT words. Each ADD keeps its original chart.

Six exchanges survive the complex eligibility filter. Each raises the paid moment across the complete 17-copy #7113 invoice. The smallest paid deterioration is about 33.91419 raw units. On the retained #7294/#7001 BIT word, all 246 adjacent shared-owned pairs use the same chart, so the eligible stock has a whole-word saving upper of exactly zero. The fixed target remains short by about 60.10390 raw units on BIT.

## Task and overlap

Changed scalar chronology scope at canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The strongest independently reproduced comparable κ stays 0.003645669928698 on #7277 at `ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea`. #5565 on #5580 and #3941/#3942 on staged544 study related reorders on older words. #7297 and #7294 keep chronology fixed. This census resolves the declared single-swap scope on both retained words. The branch inherits the two exact #7257 hosted replay prerequisites.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/adjacent-owned-add-exchange-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/adjacent-owned-add-exchange-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

Registered replay, source history, navigation, and the Git-free export passed locally. Independent recounts rebuilt both signed invoices and checked omitted paid MOVEs. The package controls reject duplicate manifest keys, duplicate source paths, and an altered word. There were no eligible BIT sites and no positive complex price, so no new native or outer candidate replay was run.

## Credit and open next questions

#5565/#5580 supply the chronology precedent, #3941/#3942 cover related exact staged544 scopes, #5590 and #7297 supply relative rank and fixed-contact accounting, #7277/#7113 supply the complex word and caller, and #7294/#7001/#6726 supply the BIT word, caller and pricing. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

Wider scalar reorder, coupled chart changes and revised boundary contracts remain open. An extension should begin with a whole-stock dependency and price bound before selecting a prototype.
